item.tib: rdzogs chen le'u gong ma'i 'grel pa gsal byed 'phrul gyi sgron me
item.coloph: rje btsun dam pa thugs kyi gser mda' 'di/ ces pa/ rje btsun tshe dbang dam pa ni rdzi bo rig pa rang shar/ thugs kyi ces pa ni kun bzang nas bdag gi bar du/ dgongs brgyud zam ma chad pa lta ba thog dbab/ byin rlabs zam ma chad pa/ nyams rgyud thog dbab/ tshigs rgyud zam ma chad pa/ snyan rgyud thog dbab/ dpe rgyud zam ma chad pa/ thugs la 'phrul yig bkra ba'o//
